user: Can I move the pieces from one place to another?
assistant: No—once a disc is dropped, it stays in that column/row. On your turn you can only drop a new Red disc into one of the columns that isn’t full, and it falls to the lowest open spot.

To win, look for a move that creates a threat Yellow can’t stop next turn.

Quick scan here:

- Your vertical in column 2 is blocked by Yellow at row 4, so that won’t win.
- Check for “3 in a row with an open playable spot” for Red.
- Also make sure Yellow doesn’t have an immediate 3-in-a-row you must block.

A good way to think: “If I drop here, what winning move do I threaten next?” Try one column mentally and see what Red line it creates.
